subject: Data Engineering
title: Structured vs Unstructured Data
description: Learn Structured vs Unstructured Data in one minute.

hook.text: A database row is structured. A customer support email is not. Most of the world's data is unstructured.

buildup.text: Structured data fits neatly in rows and columns — think spreadsheets and relational databases.

discovery.text: Unstructured data includes images, videos, PDFs, chat logs, and sensor readings.

twist.text: Over 80% of enterprise data is unstructured, yet most analytics tools only handle structured data.

climax.text: Big data tools emerged partly to process unstructured data that traditional databases couldn't handle.

punchline.text: Most data has no columns. That's the real challenge.

quiz.question: What percentage of enterprise data is estimated to be unstructured?
